changes: Android live playback automatically tries provider HLS/TS alternate once; keeps credentials, query and channel ID unchanged
Bounded 20-second prepare timeout per source; stale callbacks ignored
Distinguish reported decoder unsupported, malformed stream, network/timeout and unknown failures without exposing URLs
Retry preserves saved VOD resume position; optional installed external player selected by user
Error and recovery labels localized in Arabic, English, French, Chinese and Japanese
limitations: No software decoder embedded; device codec support remains a limit
No physical customer stream test; provider may not expose both live formats
